grammar.title: 动词与介词搭配的词组

parts.text: 动词+介词的固定短语通常可分开使用，可以有自己的宾语，并且大部分都可用于被动结构。 on prep. 在…之上 in prep. 在…内 from prep. 从…起 of prep. 属于 介词练习

rows: He always acts on his principles.
The decision was based on thorough research.
She commented on the new book.
Let's concentrate on the task at hand.
They congratulated him on his promotion.
We need to consult on this matter.
You can always count on her for support.
They decided on a date for the meeting.
The success of the project depends on careful planning.
We need to economize on our expenses.
She is about to embark on a new career path.
The scientists are experimenting on a new drug.
He always insists on doing things his way.
She leaned on the wall for support.
He lives on a modest income.
The surgeon will operate on the patient tomorrow.
She performed in many plays during her acting career.
They pride themselves on their excellent customer service.
